# Introduction

Hello! I'm Jonas Samuelsson, a data analyst and demographer at Sweden's Dental and Pharmaceutical Benefits Agency (TLV), where I work on health economics analysis, geographic accessibility modelling for pharmacies and dental care, and risk assessment. My background spans TLV, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC), and Karolinska Institutet, including a peer-reviewed 25-country Legionnaires' disease surveillance study. I've presented findings from TLV's dental market analysis to Sweden's Ministry of Health and Social Affairs, most recently as part of a baseline study of the market ahead of the 2026 tiotandvård reform. 

I hold a Master's in Demography from Stockholm University, and I work primarily in R (tidyverse) and SQL, with current interests in Bayesian methods and health economics.

Beyond data analysis, I'm deeply curious about how different societies organize themselves. I've travelled extensively across Europe, Asia, and beyond, seeking to understand demographic patterns, healthcare systems, and diverse communities, an interest that continually informs my analytical work.
